rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on overhang) with no third-party involvement or injury is a straightforward property damage claim.
claim_summary: Wind event last weekend damaged approximately four shingles on the back porch overhang. Estimated repair cost is $400 with no interior water damage or other property loss. Straightforward low-severity property damage claim.

case_facts.description: Wind blew approximately four shingles off overhang; no interior water damage
